correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and edge labels b_i=a_i*a_(i+1), image consists exactly of cyclic 101-free words: two neighboring positive edges force their middle edge. Shattered supports are cyclic 111-free because every connected component of queried edges is a vertex-disjoint path with 1 or 2 edges, permitting arbitrary endpoint selection. Marked-zero run vectors give s_k=n/(n-k)[t^k](1+t+t^2)^(n-k); VC=floor(2n/3). Partition indices into length-three blocks (at most seven possible patterns, Ldim<=2 each) gives upper 2q for n=3q and 2q+1 for n=3q+1. For n=3q+1 the root e0=0/1 both admit 2q independently selectable edge labels, yielding online depth 2q+1. No all-order Ldim for n≡2 mod3 is asserted. Independent exhaustive cycle C7 traces and online dynamic recursion gave VC4 and Ldim5; source checker inspected.
